COHABITATION AGREEMENT

This Cohabitation Agreement (this "Agreement") is made as of April 14, 2026 between Devon Achebe, residing at 88 Beech Row, Columbus, Ohio 43201, and Priya Venkataraman, residing at 412 Sycamore Lane, Columbus, Ohio 43206 (each a "Party" and together the "Parties").

RECITALS

The Parties intend to live together in a committed relationship without marrying. They do not intend to create a common-law marriage, and they understand that Ohio has not recognized common-law marriage since October 10, 1991. They wish to state their financial arrangements now, while their relationship is harmonious, so that neither has to reconstruct them later.

1. NO MARRIAGE. Nothing in this Agreement creates a marriage, a civil union, a domestic partnership, or any status that carries marital rights. Neither Party acquires any right of spousal support, dower, curtesy, elective share, or intestate succession by reason of the relationship or of this Agreement.

2. FULL DISCLOSURE. Each Party has attached a schedule of assets, liabilities, and annual income (Schedule A for Devon Achebe, Schedule B for Priya Venkataraman), which each represents to be complete and accurate as of the date above. Each Party has had the opportunity to review the other's schedule and to ask questions about it.

3. INDEPENDENT COUNSEL. Each Party has been advised in writing to obtain independent legal counsel. Devon Achebe is represented by Brightwater & Osei LLP. Priya Venkataraman has been advised to obtain counsel, has had a reasonable opportunity to do so, and knowingly waives that right after being told in plain terms what the waiver means.

4. VOLUNTARINESS. Each Party enters this Agreement voluntarily, free of duress, fraud, and undue influence, and has had at least thirty (30) days to consider it before signing.

5. SEPARATE PROPERTY. All property either Party owned before the relationship, and all property either Party acquires during it by gift, inheritance, or in that Party's sole name from that Party's separate funds, remains that Party's separate property. Neither Party acquires any interest in the other's separate property by contributing services, labor, or funds to its maintenance or improvement, except as Section 6 provides in writing.

6. JOINTLY ACQUIRED PROPERTY. Property the Parties acquire together and title in both names is owned in the proportions stated in the instrument of title or, if none is stated, equally. Either Party may require a sale and division on thirty (30) days' notice after the relationship ends.

7. THE RESIDENCE. The residence at 412 Sycamore Lane is the separate property of Priya Venkataraman. Devon Achebe will contribute $1,400 per month toward household expenses. Those contributions are payments for the use and enjoyment of the residence and do not create an ownership interest, an equitable lien, a constructive trust, or any claim in restitution.

8. HOUSEHOLD EXPENSES AND DEBTS. The Parties will share groceries, utilities, and household supplies equally. Neither Party is liable for a debt the other incurs in that Party's sole name, and neither may pledge the other's credit.

9. NO SUPPORT OBLIGATION. Neither Party will owe the other support, maintenance, or palimony of any kind on the ending of the relationship, and each waives every claim of that nature, including any claim founded on an express or implied contract, quantum meruit, unjust enrichment, or a Marvin-style theory.

10. CHILDREN. This Agreement does not address the custody, support, or parenting of any child. Those questions are governed by law and by the best interests of the child, and nothing here limits a court's authority over them.

11. AMENDMENT AND REVOCATION. This Agreement may be amended or revoked only by a writing signed by both Parties. Marriage does not revoke it, but the Parties agree to review it before marrying.

12. SEVERABILITY. If any provision is unenforceable, the rest remains in effect.

13. GOVERNING LAW. Ohio law governs this Agreement.

/s/ Devon Achebe                          /s/ Priya Venkataraman
Devon Achebe                              Priya Venkataraman
Date: April 14, 2026                      Date: April 14, 2026

STATE OF OHIO, COUNTY OF FRANKLIN
Acknowledged before me on April 14, 2026 by Devon Achebe and Priya Venkataraman.
